/* =============================================================================
 * IQA enhancements — standalone build, for iMIS sites without the UnionSuite theme
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * GENERATED by build-iqa-standalone.cjs from the UnionSuite theme sources.
 * Do not edit this file; change the theme or the builder and rebuild.
 *
 * One self-contained script: no theme CSS, theme tokens, icon font or other
 * script is needed. Its styles use private --iqae-* custom properties with
 * the stock Orion colours, so nothing the client's skin defines is read or
 * overwritten. It runs only on these two staff pages and does nothing
 * anywhere else:
 *   • IQA designer  …/QueryBuilder/Design.aspx
 *   • IQA browser   …/AsiCommon/Controls/IQA/Default.aspx
 *
 * INSTALL
 *   Upload this file (for example to the site's App_Themes folder or a CDN)
 *   and add it to the staff site's header, once:
 *     <script src="/App_Themes/YOUR_THEME/IQA-Enhancements-Standalone.js" defer></script>
 *   Remove it when the UnionSuite theme is installed: the theme brings its
 *   own copies, and this script stands down when it finds the theme.
 *
 * WHAT IT ADDS
 *   IQA designer
 *     Enhance switch (beside Save) turns the editor improvements on or off,
 *       live; remembered per browser. The "?" beside it lists them all.
 *     Header: Copy Path and Copy Key buttons; Ctrl+S / Command+S saves.
 *     Sources: Business Object search, the "Union Template" quick-add list,
 *       drag to reorder sources, Join by ID, a join tree of the relations,
 *       Branchify (adds i4u_UT_EntityAccess and Contact Key = "@LoggedInUser").
 *     Filters: type-to-filter dropdowns, compact layout, numbered groups with
 *       their order of operations, drag to reorder, value history.
 *     Display: drag columns into order, uncheck all, custom SQL editing with
 *       field and dbo. function suggestions and syntax checks.
 *     Sorting: type-to-filter dropdowns and drag to reorder.
 *     Template: HTML view with highlighting, tag pairing, {#query.…} field
 *       suggestions and Format HTML (Shift+Alt+F).
 *     Show Usage (sitemap button in the header): a drawer listing every
 *       content page, business object, panel source, communication template,
 *       alert/Process Automation task and IQA that uses the open IQA, with
 *       Copy path and Open in new tab. "Check again" rebuilds the shared list;
 *       with nowhere to save it, the results stay on the page until reload.
 *   IQA browser
 *     Quick find searches every folder by name or path, with favourites
 *     (stars), recently opened queries and recent searches.
 *
 * PREREQUISITES (on the client's iMIS; each feature degrades on its own)
 *   Quick add list and Business Object search
 *     $/_i4u_/Core/Admin/IQA Builder - Quick Add Business Object List
 *       (prompted filter DocumentName) and
 *     $/_i4u_/Core/Admin/IQA Builder - Quick Add Business Object Section,
 *       each returning DocumentName, DocumentVersionKey and Description.
 *   Branchify: the i4u_UT_EntityAccess business object in the quick-add list.
 *   Show Usage, saved for everyone: i4u_UT_Configuration with a Payload
 *     varbinary(MAX) property and write access. Without it, checks still
 *     run and their results stay on the page.
 *   IQA browser search: $/_i4u_/Core/Admin/Query Search - IQA Document Tree Taskbar;
 *     favourites: i4u_UT_UserSettings (ID, SettingsKey, Value).
 *
 * See README.md beside the builder for the full usage notes.
 * ========================================================================== */
